lines: Thanks for joining. Today we decide the launch date for the Hartmann pilot, and who owns what.
The build is stable. I ran the soak test for two days and saw no crashes.
Great. So can we launch on the third of November, or is anything blocking us?
One thing. The Azure app registration is still pending, so Outlook calendars will not sync yet.
Can we launch with Google calendars only, and add Outlook in a patch?
Yes, that works. The tenant admin gave me a slot on Thursday, so Outlook can follow next week.
From support, Hartmann asked for their pallet label format in the export.
That is a small change. I can ship it before the launch.
Then we decide: launch on the third of November with Google only, and Outlook follows in a patch.
Should we tell Hartmann about the Outlook delay before the launch?
Yes. Mei, please send them a short note tomorrow.
I will also write the rollback steps in the runbook, just in case.
And I will meet the tenant admin on Thursday and report back in the channel.
One open question: who answers the support inbox during launch week?
I can cover the mornings, but I need someone for the afternoons.
Let's park that. I will ask Sven and we come back to it on Friday.
Thanks everyone, that is all for today.
